query:
SELECT table_name, count FROM (
  SELECT 'research_publications' as table_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM research_publications
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'analytical_methods', COUNT(*) FROM analytical_methods
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'researchers', COUNT(*) FROM researchers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'research_institutions', COUNT(*) FROM research_institutions
) t;
